notes.title: Nominate Deltazone for Labor of Love!
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Awards is here yet again![/h1]
Nominate Deltazone for Labor of Love!

Deltazone has been in development since 2020, with the game officially launching on Steam in December 2022. Over the years, the development team has worked tirelessly to refine and expand the game, consistently pushing updates and implementing new features to create the most immersive and enjoyable experience possible. Our goal has always been to build a game that resonates with our community, and we’ve been dedicated to listening to feedback and evolving the game based on player input. From gameplay enhancements to visual improvements, every update reflects our commitment to delivering a high-quality experience for our players.

notes.title: Deltazone V2 is in Development!
notes.content:
[h1]Deltazone V2 is in Development![/h1]

[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]

We’re thrilled to share that Deltazone V2 is officially in the works! Our team is focused on bringing you a more optimized and smoother gameplay experience. To achieve this, we're implementing significant performance improvements and transitioning to a new networking solution, Fishnet, for better multiplayer connectivity and stability.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your ongoing support as we continue to enhance the Deltazone experience. We can’t wait for you to see what’s coming next!

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.0[/h1]

Hey everyone!

Update 0.3.0 is here, and it brings a massive overhaul to the UI, animations, and maps. Every map has been reworked to improve both visuals and gameplay flow, making for a better overall experience. All upcoming maps will follow this updated style, ensuring a consistent and polished feel throughout the game.

Right now, the map selection is smaller as I'm still actively working on them, but my plan is to release a new map every week or two until we reach around 20 maps, each designed with the new improvements in mind.

The animations have also been updated, and while they're still a work in progress, this update is a big step in the right direction. Expect even smoother and more engaging visuals as I continue refining them in future updates.

Thanks for your patience and support as I keep working to make the game better!

Here is a few pictures of the new/improved maps

notes.title: More news about Update V0.3.0
notes.content: So I lied. This update will not be for the maps... It will instead be for better animations and just a better overall system for the way I create animations. All Third Person animations will be a little bit simpler, but the first person animations will be a lot better. I realized that remaking all the maps would take a little bit of time, and I didn't want to use that much time on one thing in the game. I might just scrap all the Maps and then slowly make new and better maps.

notes.title: Thanks for giving the game a try!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you to everyone that has been playing so far.[/h3]

we hit a peak of 13 Players as of 1/15/2023 at 11:00pm EST
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42881441/e8b63ae433c2570243c1f681fcd2eb334b54b19b.png[/img]

[h3]So what does this mean for the game?[/h3]
The game will still be receiving updates. The next planned update will be sometime next month due to it being something to do with the trials and campaign mode. Not 100% sure about the campaign mode. but I will try and make some sort of story for the game.

[h3]So is this the last update until the Trials and campaign update?[/h3]
No, it wont be the last update until then. Nothing is planned for now but that doesnt mean its going to stay that way.

Thats all for now. thanks for playing!
